summary: Enhance your data skills with our course on SPSS data manipulation and Power BI visualization. Learn to analyze and present data effectively.
lede: SPSS and Power BI training helps analysts prepare structured data and turn analysis into clear, interactive reports. For professionals working with operational, survey, or research data, it covers checking and recoding variables, assessing descriptive and selected inferential results, and shaping data into models, measures, and dashboards. Learners also practise documenting transformations with SPSS Syntax and aligning statistical findings with Power BI reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, analyse, govern, or consume operational and research data using IBM SPSS Statistics and Microsoft Power BI. It suits foundation-level learners who need a structured start and intermediate users who want a more consistent workflow between statistical analysis and business intelligence reporting.
prerequisites: You need a laptop with access to IBM SPSS Statistics and Microsoft Power BI Desktop for the practical exercises. TrainingCred can provide practice datasets, analytical briefs, data dictionaries, syntax templates, Power Query files, DAX examples, and dashboard design checklists. The course focuses on operational application rather than technical engineering: AI-assisted analytics and automated refresh concepts receive guided, practical treatment, while production-scale deployment remains outside the course scope.
